content: Baphangi, kikuma kya kilumbu yi tangwa, lweku yi mupfunu ni balusonikina.
Kikuma, luzayini benu-benu buna bwa bukheti ni kilumbu kya kwisa kwa Pfumu kyakála mu kithulumukina hanga mwifi muna kisuku

Tangwa bazimbula batu: «Ngemba yi talala bikotini», amana kuzangana kwisi kota mu kithulumukina hakana henina bawu, hanga ndunza za kubuta kwena mukhetu wenina ku kifundu. Amana ka mutu ku wafwána mu kuhengamaza.
Kaasi benu, baphangi, lweku mu mudima, ndangu kilumbu kyakina kilukadilaku kya kithulumukina hanga mwifi.
Mukuma benu boosu lwenina bana ba kikhya yi bana ba mwini. Lweku bana ba phipha keti bana ba mudima.
Yi hakana ni, tunimbaku hanga batu bahika, kaasi tukalenu batemuna amana tukalenu ha tambu.
Mukuma babana bisi nimba, mu phipha bisi nimba, amana babana bisi dizedisa, mu phipha bisi dizedisa.
Kaasi betu thwenina batu ba mwini, tukalenu ha tambu. Tuvwatenu lukwikilu yi lungongu hanga miledi mya bisengu misi sweka thulu, amana kivuvu kya luhulusu hanga phwa
Kikuma Nzambi kátuyidikilaku ku khabu zandi, kaasi kikuma kya kutambula luhulusu mwena Pfumu wetu Yesu Kidisitu;
wuna wafwa kikuma kya betu ndangu kalenga tuzingisa ha kimosi yi yandi kilumbu kakwísa, twakala ba moya kondi loni bafwa.
Yi hakana, dibwisakenu mbundu muna lukwikilu benu yi benu amana disadisakenu mu kukola mu kimvuka bwosu lwisibwa hangila kedi.
Milongi yi mboti ya tsuka
Baphangi, tululombini mu kuzitisaka batu babana bisi diheka phasi ha kati dya benu, babana káheka Pfumu kiyeka kya kulutwadisaka yi kya kululwengisaka.
Bazitisakenu lawu amana bazolakenu, kikuma kya kisalu kya bawu. Zingilenu mu ngemba hana kati dya benu.
Tuluhekini kikesa, baphangi: lwengisakenu batu bakonda luzitu, hanakenu kikesa kwena batu bana beku yi kikesa, sadisenu batu bana balembwa, siphulenu mbundu kikuma kya boosu.
Tekikenu matu ni mutu kavutulaku mbela kwena mukwawu; kaasi sandakenu kosu tangwa mu kuhangaka bukheti, benu yi benu yi kwena mutu wosu.
Sangwalakenu bilumbu byosu.
Sambilakenu konda kulembwa.
Vutulakenu matondu mu mambu moosu kwena Nzambi. Yi bwabuna kisi zola Nzambi muna luzingu lwenu mwena Kidisitu Yesu.
Lukakidikisaku mihangu mya Kitembu.
Lulewulaku misamu mya bambikudi.
Zyaminenu bima byosu buna bwa bukheti, kaasi simbidilenu kina kyenina kya bukheti;
amana dikandenu ku mbi yi mitindu mya yawu myosu.
Yambula Nzambi wa ngemba kalutambika yandi-meni mu luzingu lwenu lwosu. Yambula kimutu kyenu kyosu, kitembu, moya yi lutu byakala konda kifu kikuma kya kilumbu kina kakwísa Pfumu wetu Yesu Kidisitu.
Yandi wulutedini kenina wa kusila mbundu, amana kalúngisabwa phi.
Baphangi, sambilakenu phi kikuma kya betu.
Hanenu mboti mosi yatoma kwena baphangi boosu.
Yilubokwadidibwa, muna zina dya Pfumu: tangisenu mukanda wawu kwena baphangi boosu.
Yambula khenda za Pfumu wetu Yesu Kidisitu zakala yi benu.
